title: Leroy's NEW 3,000 Horsepower Billet LS

event_target.name: FL2K (auto-caption 'FL 2K')

other_purchases.fact: Cleetus bought Greg Biffle's 2004 Roush Racing Ford Taurus Cup car (chassis RK195) at a Mecum auction (caption 'Mikum'); hammer ~USD 47,000 per auctioneer recap

cars.build_version: Leroy - billet tall-deck LS, bigger turbos, new transmission (2026 build)

base_vehicle.note: not restated in this video; C5 per task brief

block.desc: billet tall-deck LS block; ~100 lb lighter on the nose than the previous iron LS block

heads.desc: Mast 'Moses 2.0' heads (caption 'masked Moses 2.0'; raw caption brand uncertain); previous engine used Mast cathedral-port heads

displacement.note: described only as more stroke / bigger engine than before

oiling.desc: dry sump with billet dry-sump pan (caption 'motion billet dry sump pan', brand low confidence) with lines integrated into the pan; dry-sump lines routed through/around headers

fuel_pump.desc: cam-driven mechanical fuel pump on the engine

engine.notes: Delivered at ~2-3 a.m. the night before install; Zach installed it overnight

turbo_size_mm.note: 'power on these 88s' said about the bigger turbos; inferred as 88 mm, medium confidence

boost_psi.plan: ~60 psi mentioned by Pete as future level requiring more rear gear

power_adder.notes: New bigger turbos bolted on without modification; new up-pipes header-to-turbo, wastegates off the front as before; larger downpipe/bullhorn exhaust both sides; new cold side

transmission.notes: New transmission (see 5ibvcauFris: Liberty). Front of trans needed a riser plate; new 1/2 in CNC mid plate moved engine forward; adapter plate between bellhousing and trans means trans must come out in three pieces to reach clutch adjustment; shifter extender from Liberty

clutch.desc: clutch with dyno tune-up weights installed for now

rear_end.note: Pete warned more rear gear may be needed at ~60 psi boost

weight_lb.change: roughly 150 lb lighter if everything goes right (plus driver lost 30 lb)

targets.note: bigger turbos to go 'crazy town'; mainly a total rewrite needing sorting (gearing, trans, clutch, engine, turbos)

cars.build_version: Mullet - tall-deck big block, new dry sump (2026)

heads.desc: same heads reused from previous engine

rotating_assembly.desc: taller deck allows longer/beefier rod with larger rod bolt ('like a Hemi rod'); 55 mm camshaft core for rigidity

boost_psi.history: both previous engines were hurt at ~50 psi; new engine expected OK above 50 psi

chassis.desc: back from Cameron Johnson Race Cars
